decks.notes: The main focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to use a combination of cheap counterspells and card draw spells to maintain control of the game while deploying small, aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Tolarian Terror to quickly close out the game. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure on the board, with a mix of countermagic and efficient creatures to stay ahead in the tempo game.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost aggressive creatures and efficient countermagic. By using cards like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent, the deck aims to apply early pressure while maintaining control of the game with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck also includes card draw spells like Ponder and Deep Analysis to ensure a steady stream of threats and answers. Overall, the Mono Blue Aggro deck seeks to establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a swift victory.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize mana acceleration and land destruction to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. By ramping up quickly with cards like Arbor Elf and Utopia Sprawl, the deck aims to play big threats like Annoyed Altisaur and Avenging Hunter as early as possible. Skred and Thermokarst provide removal and disruption, while Mwonvuli Acid-Moss helps to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The goal is to keep up the pressure and establish board dominance in order to win the game quickly.

The deck focuses on using control elements like Counterspell and Journey to Nowhere to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gaining card advantage with Squadron Hawk and Preordain. The Gates act as mana fixing and provide additional benefits with cards like Guardian of the Guildpact and Dawnbringer Cleric. Prismatic Strands serves as a protective spell, while Sacred Cat and The Modern Age help with early game defense. The combination of control elements and gate synergies allows the deck to outlast opponents and dominate the late game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the pace of the game through counterspells and removal spells, while also utilizing card draw and graveyard manipulation to outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to stabilize the board with efficient threats like Gurmag Angler and Fallaji Archaeologist, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Counterspell and Snuff Out. By carefully managing resources and maximizing card advantage, this Dimir Control deck seeks to outlast the opponent and eventually secure victory through card advantage and powerful late-game threats.

The deck focuses on using Artifact creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of low-cost, high-power creatures. By efficiently utilizing mana-fixing artifacts and drawing cards, the deck aims to flood the board with creatures like Myr Enforcer and Frogmite, while boosting their power with cards like All That Glitters. The inclusion of Thraben Inspector provides a bit of card advantage and flexibility. With efficient mana production and powerful synergies between artifacts and creatures, the deck aims to quickly take control of the game and overwhelm the opponent.

The central idea of this deck is to stack up auras on low-cost creatures, creating powerful threats that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Ancestral Mask, Ethereal Armor, and Armadillo Cloak, along with creatures like Slippery Bogle and Gladecover Scout, the deck aims to deal damage fast and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Utopia Sprawl and Abundant Growth helps with mana fixing and ramping up to play multiple auras in a turn. Overall, the deck focuses on aggression and burst damage to secure victory in a Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this Pauper 1 vs 1 Control - Gates deck is to use a combination of control spells, such as Counterspell and Journey to Nowhere, along with the synergy between Gates like Basilisk Gate and Sea Gate to slow down and control the opponent's board. The deck also includes some card draw and creature recursion with Squadron Hawk and Prismatic Strands to maintain card advantage and board presence. With a focus on controlling the game and outlasting the opponent, this deck aims to establish a dominant position on the battlefield and grind out a victory over time.

This deck focuses on utilizing Gates to control the board and stall out the game. Cards like Prismatic Strands and Journey to Nowhere help keep opposing threats at bay, while Counterspell and Dispel provide disruption. Squadron Hawk helps with card advantage, while the Guardian of the Guildpact acts as a solid defensive creature. The deck also includes some life gain with Sacred Cat and Dawnbringer Cleric. Brainstorm and Preordain help with card selection and ensuring the deck runs smoothly. The goal is to outlast the opponent and win through attrition.

The key focus of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy using a mix of counterspells and removal spells. The deck also aims to generate value through cards like Augur of Bolas and Murmuring Mystic, while also having some finishers in Crimson Fleet Commodore and Tolarian Terror. The inclusion of cards like Preordain and Brainstorm helps with card selection and manipulation, allowing the player to find the right answers at the right time. The deck utilizes a combination of burn spells and creature threats to maintain control of the game.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Journey to Nowhere. The deck also includes artifacts like Relic of Progenitus and Experimenta Synthesizer to provide additional value and flexibility. The mana base is designed to ensure a smooth curve and consistency in playing the aggressive creatures and spells, while also allowing for potential card draw and recursion with cards like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher. Ultimately, the goal is to apply constant pressure and close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with artifact creatures and boosting their power with equipment like All That Glitters. Utilizing cards like Springleaf Drum and Thoughtcast to quickly draw into more threats, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. Metallic Rebuke provides some control elements, while Reverse Engineer helps to refill the hand with more resources. With efficient mana production and a low mana curve, the deck can quickly establish a dominant board presence and close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly summoning cheap artifact creatures and leveraging cards that provide card advantage, such as Thoughtcast and Reverse Engineer. By using mana acceleration cards like Springleaf Drum, the deck can flood the board with powerful creatures like Frogmite and Myr Enforcer. All That Glitters boosts the power of creatures, while Metallic Rebuke provides some control elements. The mana base consists of artifact lands and utility lands to support the aggressive playstyle of the deck.

The main concept of this UR Control deck is to maintain control over the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw. The deck aims to control the board by using cards like Skred, Lightning Bolt, and Counterspell, while also digging deeper into the deck with cards like Thought Scour and Brainstorm. The deck also includes win conditions in Cryptic Serpent, Murmuring Mystic, and various fleet creatures. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the game and outlasting opponents through card advantage and timely removal.

This mono green aggro deck focuses on playing efficient creatures early in the game and boosting them with pump spells to rapidly deal damage to the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Nettle Sentinel and Burning-Tree Emissary to generate quick mana advantage and overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures. Key cards like Rancor and Hunger of the Howlpack help to enhance the power of these creatures and push through damage efficiently. The deck aims to win the game as quickly as possible through aggressive tactics and a relentless onslaught of threats.

The deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent by using efficient burn spells and creatures with abilities that deal additional damage. It aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize or gain control of the game. The deck includes a mix of direct damage spells like Lava Spike and Lightning Bolt, along with creatures like Firebrand Archer and Thermo-Alchemist that can chip away at the opponent's life total. The deck also includes card draw spells like Reckless Impulse to ensure a steady stream of threats and burn spells.
